summary: Caledonia Mining Corporation Plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing its abridged and unaudited Q3 and nine-month 2026 results, plus notice of a management conference call. Revenue rose 10.5% to US$78.9 million on a realized gold price of US$4,134/oz, though gold sales fell to 19,082 oz and profit after tax dropped 39.3% to US$11.3 million on a US$12.9 million non-cash derivative fair-value loss. The Board declared a quarterly dividend of US$0.14 per share and revised 2026 guidance. This is a routine earnings release mapped to a US quarterly report, not a special situation.
